title: 第2616章 乱虚空间第2615章 扩大乾坤鼎的空间
slug: 我装了三年废物出手人间无敌
content_zh:
随着乾坤鼎不断朝着乱虚空间深处飞去，楚云感觉周围传来的撕扯之力越来越强。
一开始，他还能凭借体内浑厚的星力支撑。
但是到了后面，他体内的星力就像被什么东西不断抽取一般，快速流逝。
楚云的脸色逐渐变得苍白，额头上也渗出细密的汗珠。
姬沐雪见状，连忙问道：“殿主，你没事吧？”
楚云没有回答，而是操控乾坤鼎继续前行。
他想看看前面究竟是什么地方，居然能让乾坤鼎消耗如此多的星力。
很快，他发现四周的空间裂缝开始发生变化。
虽然空间裂缝依然十分密集，但是裂缝与裂缝之间的间隔，却比之前大了许多。
而在一些裂缝边缘，出现的修士尸体也开始风化。
显然，这些修士已经死去很久。
见到这一幕，楚云意念一动。
只见悬浮在半空中的乾坤鼎瞬间缩小，随后消失不见。
下一刻，楚云三人的身影凭空显现，落在一处空间裂缝前。
姬沐雪刚落地，便看见楚云满头大汗。
当下疑惑道：“殿主，怎么了？”
楚云伸手擦去额头上的汗珠，沉声道：“这乱虚空间里面有一股力量，一直在消耗我的星力。”
“乾坤鼎虽然能够帮我们抵挡一部分空间裂缝，但是消耗太大，我支撑不住。”
“接下来想要继续深入，只能用其他办法。”
说话间，他走到一具已经风化大半的干尸前，仔细打量起来。

只见这具干尸身上的衣衫，已经腐烂得不成样子。
不过从残留的气息来看，此人生前的修为应该不低。
楚云取出拓跋川给的地图，对照周围的环境看了一眼后，开口道：“这里应该就是地图标记的终点了。”
“再往前，便是连星主境修士都不敢轻易进入的区域。”
说到这里，他看向梦青璃。
“梦长老，你能看出这具尸体死亡多久了吗？”
梦青璃缓步走上前来，仔细观察片刻后，开口道：“根据尸体的风化程度判断，他至少已经死去五百年。”
楚云轻轻点头。
梦青璃乃是上清宫宫主，见识自然不是一般人可比。
对于她的推断，楚云没有丝毫怀疑。
“五百年前的修士，距离我们所在的时代并不算太久，没有太大的参考价值。”
楚云抬头看向乱虚空间深处。
只见前方空间裂缝纵横交错，银白色的光芒不断闪烁，仿佛一张随时会吞噬一切的巨网。
“继续前行。”
“不过你们一定要小心，这里的空间裂缝十分强大，一旦被吸住，几乎必死无疑。”
姬沐雪和梦青璃同时点头。
当下三人避开周围的空间裂缝，施展身法，朝着乱虚空间深处掠去。
由于不能释放神识探查，他们只能依靠肉眼和感知判断前方的危险。
一路上，三人不断左闪右避。
有好几次，空间裂缝几乎是贴着他们的身体划过。

尤其是那些移动的空间裂缝，根本毫无征兆。
稍有不慎，便会被直接切成两半。
约莫一炷香后，前方突然出现一片平坦干燥的沙地。
沙地并不大，周围被一道道空间裂缝包围。
而在沙地中央，竖立着半块石碑。
content_en:
As the Qiankun Cauldron continued to fly towards the depths of the chaotic void space, Chu Yun felt that the tearing force coming from around him was getting stronger and stronger.
At the beginning, he could still rely on the strong star power in his body to support him.
But later on, the star power in his body drained away quickly as if it was being continuously extracted by something.
Chu Yun's face gradually turned pale, and beads of sweat appeared on his forehead.
Seeing this, Ji Muxue quickly asked: "Palace Master, are you okay?"
Chu Yun did not answer, but controlled the Qiankun Ding to continue moving forward.
He wanted to see what place was ahead that could actually make the Qiankun Cauldron consume so much star power.
Soon, he discovered that the space cracks around him began to change.
Although the space cracks are still very dense, the distance between cracks is much larger than before.
At the edges of some cracks, the corpses of the monks that appeared began to weather.
Obviously, these monks have been dead for a long time.
Seeing this scene, Chu Yun had an idea.
The Qiankun Cauldron suspended in mid-air shrank instantly and then disappeared.
The next moment, the figures of Chu Yun and the others appeared out of thin air and landed in front of a space crack.
As soon as Ji Muxue landed, she saw Chu Yun sweating profusely.
Immediately he asked in confusion: "Palace Master, what's wrong?"
Chu Yun stretched out his hand to wipe the sweat from his forehead and said solemnly: "There is a force in this chaotic space that has been consuming my star power."
"Although the Qiankun Ding can help us resist some space cracks, the consumption is too great and I can't support it."
"If you want to go deeper, you can only use other methods."
While he was talking, he walked up to a mostly weathered mummy and looked at it carefully.
I saw that the clothes on this mummy were rotten to the point of disgrace.
However, judging from the remaining aura, this person's cultivation level during his lifetime should not be low.
Chu Yun took out the map given by Tuoba Chuan, took a look at the surrounding environment, and said, "This should be the end point marked on the map."
"Further forward, there is an area that even Star Lord Realm monks dare not enter easily."
Having said this, he looked at Meng Qingli.
"Elder Meng, can you tell how long this corpse has been dead?"
Meng Qingli walked forward slowly, observed carefully for a moment, and then said: "Judging from the degree of weathering of the body, he has been dead for at least five hundred years."
Chu Yun nodded slightly.
Meng Qingli is the master of Shangqing Palace, so her knowledge is naturally not comparable to that of ordinary people.
Chu Yun had no doubts about her inference.
"The monks from five hundred years ago were not too far away from our era, so they don't have much reference value."
Chu Yun raised his head and looked into the depths of the chaotic space.
I saw cracks in the space in front of me crisscrossing each other, and silver-white light flashing continuously, like a giant net that could swallow everything at any time.
"Keep going."
"But you must be careful. The space cracks here are very powerful. Once you are sucked in, you will almost certainly die."
Ji Muxue and Meng Qingli nodded at the same time.
At this moment, the three of them avoided the surrounding space cracks, used their body skills, and swept towards the depths of the chaotic void space.
Since they cannot release their spiritual sense to detect, they can only rely on their naked eyes and perception to judge the danger ahead.
Along the way, the three of them kept dodging left and right.
Several times, space cracks almost passed through their bodies.
Especially those moving space cracks, there is no warning at all.
If you are not careful, it will be cut in half directly.
After about a stick of incense, a flat, dry sandy land suddenly appeared in front of us.
The sandy land is not big and is surrounded by space cracks.
In the middle of the sand, half a stone tablet stood.
